    14	# common-passage probes. Ordinary WASD completion is NOT a movie run and is
    15	# never reported as one. No setters, teleports, rail grants, forced [F] or
    16	# rescue exist in this path; the harness's own no-rescue and stall/timeout
    17	# failure behaviour is preserved untouched.
    18	#

    20	# common-movie-candidate-runtime with action=continue.

**Time**: transport startedAt 22:14:19Z → report 22:19:51Z. 5.5 of 15 min used.

## Gates (CPU-only, before launch)
| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| manifest sha256 | `8962a7b2…46962` — **exact match** |
| `bash -n` launcher | OK |
| `node --check` ×4 probe files | OK |
| relative+dynamic-literal imports | 13 modules, 11 edges, **0 missing** |
| bare specifiers | all `node:*` + `playwright-core` (installed). `"x"` = doc-comment false positive in `sourceSnapshot.mjs:132` |
| `evidence.mjs` exported helpers | all 8 imported names real (`openParavoxia, waitReady, readState, frameStats, hideUi, showUi, SWIFTSHADER, CAPTURE_TIER`); used unchanged |
| preview daemon pid 2144696 | alive, 53m |
| HTTP pins | index + bundle sha **match** served bytes |
| DISPLAY=:0, SWIFTSHADER unset | headed hardware path |

Two concrete launcher faults corrected (launcher only; no game source, no producer receipt):
1. log dir was `logs/common-movie-candidate-prep` → `logs/common-movie-candidate-runtime` (my owned dir).
2. the global `pgrep` mislabelled "owned by this session" — claim removed; ownership now asserted only from `cleanup-receipt.json`, census relabelled "NOT an ownership claim". No process killed; root preview untouched.

## Measurements — 3 cold runs, bound 100 s
| Run | Elapsed | Bound | Exit | Stop | Beat | Rescues | pageErrors | Cleanup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 36 348 ms | 100 s | 0 | reached-beat:done | done | 0 | [] | stopped |
| 2 | 36 425 ms | 100 s | 0 | reached-beat:done | done | 0 | [] | stopped |
| 3 | 36 262 ms | 100 s | 0 | reached-beat:done | done | 0 | [] | stopped |

Variance 163 ms across runs. 37 frames each. Renderer all 3: `ANGLE (NVIDIA Corporation, NVIDIA GB10/PCIe, OpenGL 4.5.0)`, `headed=true`, `swiftshaderAllowed=false`, tier `hardware-high`. Cold browser identity distinct per run (run-1 pid 2246629 present in census, gone by run 2).

## Movie-lane proof (not manual)
URL all 3: `…/?story=ch13-common&journeyprobe=1&debug=1&movie=1`. Autopilot **active in 202/203 trace samples**; `routeAction`, `clock` advance; `teleportNudgesTotal: 0`. No WASD substitution.

## Acceptance data (shipped `__paravoxiaCommonGround` diagnostic) — identical all 3 runs
`stage: arrived`, **`terraUnits: 18`** ✓, **`workerUnits: 18`** ✓, **`committed: true`** ✓, `comparisonProved: true`, `finalReferenceOffered: true`, `finalReferenceOccupied: false`.

## MISSING EVIDENCE (why this is not a pass)
- **`anc.cg.complete` and `anc.cg.handback` never fired** in any observed ledger/event stream. They appear only in `beatAnchorsExpected` (contract) and in the game's own declared `diagnostic.anchors` array — declaration is not observation.
- **Anchor sequence 5 is unaccounted in all 3 runs**: ledger goes seq 4 (`anc.cg.independent-test`) → seq 6 (`null`). A transition existed and was not captured at `--sample-ms 100`. This is exactly where `complete` would sit. I do not claim it fired.
- Observed anchors (all 3, identical): 1 `reciprocal-reference` · 2 `reciprocal-crossed` · 3 `final-reference-offered` · 4 `independent-test` · 6 `null`.
- **`readState.lane` is absent** from `finalState` (keys: anchor, auditWorker, autopilot, beat, health, markerLabel, milestones, objectiveId, prompts, workOrder). Lane is proven by request URL + autopilot, **not** by a shipped readState lane field as required.
- **H→E uncredited-2 transient not proven.** Only terminal 18/18 captured; `physicalDiagnostics` holds final state only. Per instruction I do not treat final 18 as dense transient proof.
- The harness itself sets **`outcomeIsAcceptance: false`** on all 3.

## Objective lifecycle (identical all 3 runs, 11 trace entries)
`ch13:common:reciprocal` ("Far reference · check my route") → text-change to actionable "Walk the guide line…" → clear at `reciprocal-crossed` → `ch13:common:offer-final-reference` ("[F] Offer this end", health `ready`) → clear at `final-reference-offered` → `ch13:common:release` → clear at beat `done`, anchor null. Marker labels parity-exact; every standing work order retains a verb/input; **guidance cleared cleanly at `done`** (no stale objective, no `missing-marker`).

## Objective visual defects
- `attempt-…-run1/0001-strip-ch13-common.png`, beat ch13-common, t≈0 s: **3D viewport fully black**; only debug HUD panels and the objective card render. Boot frame. Corroborated by size (93 KB / percept 4.2 KB vs ~1.1 MB for all later frames). Same size signature in runs 2 and 3.
- `0032-beat-done.png`: world renders fully, HUD and objective card present, no letterbox/scanline artifact, no wrong-era glimpse. No taste verdict offered.

## FPS
**Not measured** — the journey-probe lane emits no rAF/fps field. No fps claim is made.

## Cleanup
All 3 `cleanup-receipt.json`: `state: stopped`, `cleanupCompleted: true`, `stopsOnlyProbeOwnedSession: true`. Root preview daemon 2144696 never touched, still serving. `flock` fd9 held exclusively for the whole sequence and released; no contender timeout. (Note: `summary.json .cleanup` shows `sessionStopped:false` — it is written pre-`finally` and is superseded by the receipt, per the receipt's own `supersedesForCleanupState`.)

## Artifacts
- Report: `/home/thomasphillip/Projects/vox/.codex/production-runs/2026-09-05-after-the-hearth/common-movie-candidate-runtime-report.json`
- Captures: `…/verifier/captures/common-movie-candidate/attempt-20260906T221545Z-run{1,2,3}/` — 37 PNGs each + `summary.json` + `trace.ndjson` (3.85 MB) + `source-snapshot/` + `cleanup-receipt.json`
- Preflight receipts: `…/verifier/captures/common-movie-candidate/preflight-ok-{1788732945917,1788732984909,1788733023979}.json`
- Logs: `…/logs/common-movie-candidate-runtime/launcher-20260906T221545Z.log` + `attempt-…-run{1,2,3}.log`
- `probeSha256`: `bab7c6339ed6c02fdfee2b5273fd64b684e6a3462d463a1bab33b8e09ef93a36` (reconstructable: true)

**Caveats**: 3-run COMMON matrix only — no station-to-chapter or full-story claim. No variant matrix (mobile/reduced-motion/low-tier) run. Wrapper exit 0 is **not** used as an acceptance claim. Nothing deleted; all prior byte snapshots and capture attempts preserved. No game source, build, full suite, or producer/control file modified.
